<b>Cómo se ordena.</b> Rendimiento seman: How you are ranked. Weekly performance = what you hold now (weekly account plus what it is working on: open bets at cash-out value, rounds still being played) minus what you held when the week began, minus anything handed to you (the weekly refill, top-ups, vouchers). Wins and losses count. The accumulated account, the Store and the Exchange do not.
<b>El mínimo semanal.</b> Para seguir en: The weekly minimum. To stay in the challenge you have to bet in at least {mercados} and play at least {rondas} during the week. Miss either one when the week closes and you lose the week automatically: you take the week's punishment (in place of whoever finished last, so it can be several people) and earn no reward, whatever your result. Practice rounds do not count, a round counts once it is finished, and an account created during the week is exempt for that first week.
It starts with the week of {fecha}.

Elige un nivel de riesgo y manda al poll: Pick a risk level and send the chicken across lane after lane. Every lane you clear raises your multiplier, and every lane has a chance of a speeding car. Cash out any time after the first lane. The chance of surviving each lane: Easy 92%, Medium 85%, Hard 75%, Hardcore 60%. Return to player: 97%.
Gánale al crupier llegando a 21. Un blac: Beat the dealer to 21. Three-to-two on a natural.
Acércate más a 21 que el crupier sin pas: Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Blackjack pays 3 to 2. The dealer stands on every 17. You can double down on your first two cards and split a pair once. Cards are dealt from a freshly shuffled six-deck shoe every hand.
Gira la rueda. Échale la culpa a la rued: Spin the wheel. Blame the wheel.
Ruleta europea con un solo cero. Elige e: European roulette with a single zero. Pick a chip value, tap the table to place bets, then spin. A single number pays 35 to 1, a dozen or column pays 2 to 1, and red/black, odd/even and high/low pay 1 to 1. Zero loses every outside bet.
Elige un número. Mira cómo el cohete lo: Pick a number. Watch the rocket ignore it.
Elige un multiplicador objetivo de 1.01x: Choose a target multiplier from 1.01x to 1,000,000x. If the rocket reaches your target, you win your bet times the target. The chance of winning is 99 divided by your target, so higher targets pay more but hit less often.
Heads or tails. The oldest bad idea.
Canta águila o sol y lanza. El clásico p: Call heads or tails and flip. Classic pays 1.98x. Streak mode makes you call the same side several flips in a row, up to ten: two in a row pays 3.96x, three pays 7.92x, ten pays 1,013.76x. One wrong flip ends it. Return to player: 99%.
One card each. Higher wins. Ties go to war.
Tú y el crupier reciben una carta cada u: You and the dealer get one card each from a fresh six-deck shoe, aces high. Higher card wins even money. On a tie you go to war: you match your bet, you each get one more card, and you win if yours is at least as high (your original bet pays even, the raise comes back). If you cannot cover the raise you surrender for half your bet. Side bets: Tie pays 12 to 1 when the first two cards match in rank, and Coloured Tie pays 26 to 1 when they match in rank and in colour. The main bet returns about 97%, the side bets about 96%.
Slide the line. Roll the number.
The roll is a number from 0.00 to 99.99. Roll Over wins when the roll lands on your number or higher. Roll Under wins when it lands below it. Slide the line, or type a multiplier, a number or a chance: they all move together. Chances run from 0.01% (pays 9,900x) to 98%. Return to player: 99%.
Abre casillas. Esquiva las bombas. Vete: Open tiles. Dodge the bombs. Leave while you can.
Elige una cuadrícula (25, 36, 49 o 64 ca: Pick a grid (25, 36, 49 or 64 tiles) and how many bombs are hiding in it. Every safe tile you open raises your multiplier, and you can cash out after any of them. Open a bomb and the round is over. More bombs means a bigger jump per tile. The bombs are placed by the server the moment you bet and never sent to your browser until the round ends. Return to player: 99%.
Seven holes. Whack the one with a mole in it.
Siete hoyos, y en cada ronda de 1 a 6 es: Seven holes, and 1 to 6 of them hide a mole each round. Pick a hole. If a mole is in it you win the round and your multiplier multiplies, and you can cash out or whack again in a fresh round. If the hole is empty you lose everything. Fewer moles means a bigger payout per hit. With 3 moles the first hit pays 2.24x. Return to player: 96%.
Sube ocho pisos. Una casilla mala y te c: Climb eight floors. One bad tile and you fall.
Sube una torre de ocho filas. Cada fila: Climb a tower of eight rows. Every row hides traps and you pick one tile per row. Pick safe and you climb and your multiplier grows. Pick a trap and you fall. Cash out after any row. Easy is four tiles with one trap per row, and it goes up to Master: four tiles with three traps. The traps are placed by the server at the start and stay hidden until the climb ends. Return to player: 96%.
Hay una carta boca arriba. ¿Mayor o meno: A card is up. Higher or lower? Stack the streak.
Sale una carta. Adivina si la siguiente: A card is dealt. Guess whether the next card is higher or lower. A card of the same rank counts as a win either way, which is why both guesses can look likely. Every guess pays 96% divided by its chance, so a safe guess pays a little and a long shot pays a lot: with a Queen showing, lower or same wins 92.31% of the time and pays 1.04x, higher or same wins 15.38% of the time and pays 6.24x.
